description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2147/30 of 29.10.2019, Kalutara D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land parcel records, including changes to ownership details, land extents, encumbrances, and servitude rights for various land parcels in different districts. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, title amendments, and property ownership matters.
